Case ID: 1140
Case Type: IT Ticket
Date: 2025-04-01
Handled By: IT - Omar Singh
Customer or Requestor: Internal Employee - Grace Turner
Title: Password reset request linked to suspected phishing

Issue Description
An employee reported that a password reset prompt appeared after clicking a suspicious email link and asked whether the account had been compromised.

Steps Taken
- Immediately disabled active sessions and forced a password reset through the identity platform.
- Reviewed sign-in logs for unfamiliar IP addresses, failed attempts, and abnormal geolocation events.
- Examined the reported email and confirmed it matched a current phishing campaign targeting retail organizations.
- Checked whether the employee had entered credentials into the phishing page and whether MFA prevented account takeover.

Resolution
Reset the employee's credentials, confirmed no unauthorized login succeeded, and documented the event as a contained phishing-related security ticket.

Follow-Up
Security Awareness sent a reminder bulletin to staff about the active phishing pattern.

Reference Documents
- Information Security Policy Set
- IT Ticket Resolution Guide v2
